cmpu_fast_add = {
 scope = country
 is_shown = { is_player = yes }
 is_valid = { always = yes }
 ai_is_valid = { always = no }
 effect = {
if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cmpu_fast_steps } } set_variable = { name = cmpu_fast_steps value = 0 } }
change_variable = { name = cmpu_fast_steps add = 1 }
clamp_variable = { name = cmpu_fast_steps min = 0 max = 10000 }
remove_modifier = cmpu_fast_efficiency
if = { limit = { NOT = { var:cmpu_fast_steps = 0 } } add_modifier = { name = cmpu_fast_efficiency multiplier = var:cmpu_fast_steps } }
 }
}
